column1: # THE LINT REGISTRY: every repo-reading spec the pre-push `sbt` check may run (`scripts/hooks/pre-push --lint-plan`),
# and the pushed paths that select it. One row a spec: `<module>:<package.Spec>` TAB `<reads>` [TAB `<why>`].
# <reads>, space-separated, any of them selecting it -- WHAT THE SPEC OPENS, nothing wider (the owner, 2026-11-21:
# agentctl keeps a change's verdict when main moved only outside what its checks read, and the 175 `@repo` rows this
# table had, selected by any script, workflow, skill or test-tree path, made every two changes share a lint):
#   <glob>   a pushed path matching this bash pattern (`*` crosses `/`, but a leading `*/` is ONE directory, a module:
#            `*/src/test/*` never reaches android/app/src/test/): `.github/workflows/*.yml` for a spec keeping the
#            workflows, `*/src/main/scala/*` for one scanning the production sources, a file for one it reads by name.
#            A FILE a row names (no pattern character) also runs the sbt check itself, alone (the hook's plan: a
#            Dockerfile-only push ran none); a pattern selects its spec only when the check runs anyway
#   *        every push the sbt check runs for: the standing lints
#   @code    nothing besides its own code: every row but a `-` one is selected by the code its spec is compiled with,
#            a test-side path (a test, it, page or fixtures tree, testkit/, the build) whose compile plan holds the
#            spec's module's Test config; `@code` is the row of a spec that opens no file of the tree
#   @repo    every path: a spec that reads the whole tree (none does, 2026-11-21)
#   @gitops  it reads the GitOps manifests too: in the plan only with them in place (PREPUSH_GITOPS=1: infra/bin/
#            fetch-gitops fetched them); scripts/gitops-specs runs these rows against a movies-gitops push
#   @per-file  beside its reads: the spec judges each file alone (NoSettingFallbackSpec: no file defaults a setting), so
#            two changes meet in its verdict only through a file both change or its own code; agentctl's MINIMAL RECHECKS
#            counts it shared only then (pre-push --per-file-lints). Proved by scripts/ci/lint_per_file_check.py (a file
#            changed, twinned or emptied, no other file's verdict moves) and by reading the spec; <why> says how it
#            judges a file. A spec comparing files (a parity, a registry, a set of callers) is never marked.
#   -        never in the plan; <why> says why (it boots a server, another check runs it, ...)
# A production source or a main resource the code under test reads through the classpath is no read of a row (the
# unit tests own it): a spec reading production sources from disk names them (`*/src/main/scala/*`).
# A spec is selected by this table, not by its name (review 2026-11-06, D3: LoadIndependentTestsSpec and
# InMemoryStoresRoundTripSpec matched no name pattern and turned Main red 7 times). scripts/hooks/lint-registry-test.sh
# fails when a repo-reading spec -- a tools/ No*/*Lint* spec, any deploy/ spec, one using a source-scan helper
# (ScalaSourceScan, ModuleSources, SourceTrees, RepoRoot, WorkflowText), or ANY SPEC READING A CHECKED-IN OR GENERATED
# ARTEFACT (a literal naming a repo path or a root file, a classpath resource it opens, any resource opener or RepoFile
# call: the reader lint, scripts/ci/lint_registry_reads.py --missing; --suggest prints the row it wants) -- has no row
# here, or a row names no spec, or misses a path its spec's source names (`--reads <spec>` shows them).
# THE READS ARE PROVED BY RUNNING THE SPECS: scripts/ci/lint_reads_trace.py runs each spec alone in its own JVM and names
# every tracked file it opened that its row does not select (seen by the file's access time: any API, any child);
# `--suggest <spec>` prints the row its reads want. Run it for a new or changed row (2026-11-21: every row, 0 misses).
# THE ARTEFACT READERS (the owner, 2026-11-18): every spec that reads a checked-in or generated artefact -- a repo path, a
# root file, a classpath resource -- has its row, so a change to that artefact selects it before landing (Main #2547/#2550,
# #2601). scripts/ci/lint_registry_reads.py --missing names a reader with no row; --suggest prints the row it would want.
